nodes.description: Public token name string, set once in the constructor to 'ZOOT MEME INU'.
Public token symbol string, set once in the constructor to 'ZOONU'.
Public token decimals, fixed to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply (1e30) minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount; written by approve and transferFrom.
ZOOT constructor; sets metadata, mints the full supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
View function returning the balance of a given token owner.
View function returning the remaining allowance of a spender for an owner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no zero-address checks.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Spends allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
SafeMath helper for addition with overflow require().
SafeMath helper for subtraction with underflow require(b <= a).
SafeMath helper for multiplication with overflow require().
SafeMath helper for division with require(b > 0).
Caller-controlled address used as owner key, recipient and allowance owner across ZOOT.
Unchecked arithmetic '_totalSupply - balances[address(0)]' in totalSupply; can underflow if address(0) balance is non-zero.
State writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] driven by user-supplied 'tokens' in transfer.
State writes balances[from] and balances[to] driven by user-supplied 'tokens' in transferFrom.
Allowance deduction allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom; authorization depends on user-controlled msg.sender and 'from'.
Address parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf, used as the mapping lookup key.
Address parameter tokenOwner of allowance, used as the outer allowance mapping key.
Address parameter spender of allowance, used as the inner allowance mapping key.
Address parameter spender of approve, the account being granted allowance.
Uint parameter tokens of approve, the allowance amount written to storage.
Address parameter 'to' of transfer, the recipient of the token amount.
Uint parameter tokens of transfer, the amount debited and credited.
Address parameter 'from' of transferFrom, the account whose tokens are spent.
Address parameter 'to' of transferFrom, the recipient of the token amount.
Uint parameter tokens of transferFrom, the amount spent and credited.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the token name state variable.
Constructor assigns the token symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the initial minted amount.
Constructor writes the full supply into balances[msg.sender].
Constructor credits the initial supply to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply for its return value.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for its return value.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction on supply and zero-address balance.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested owner.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping for owner and spender.
approve writes the granted amount into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve uses caller-controlled msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient.
transfer debits the caller-controlled msg.sender balance.
transfer performs balance state updates driven by the user-supplied amount.
transfer delegates the debit to safeSub to prevent underflow.
transfer delegates the credit to safeAdd to prevent overflow.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping for the spender.
transferFrom authorizes spending using caller-controlled msg.sender as spender.
transferFrom performs balance state updates driven by the user-supplied amount.
transferFrom deducts allowance without a zero-address or self-spend guard.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient credit.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the inner allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter is the allowance grantee key in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance amount written by approve.
to parameter is the recipient address used by transfer.
to parameter selects the balance slot credited in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount debited and credited by transfer.
tokens parameter feeds the safeSub/safeAdd balance writes in transfer.
from parameter is the source account spent by transferFrom.
from parameter selects the balance slot debited in transferFrom.
to parameter is the recipient address used by transferFrom.
to parameter selects the balance slot credited in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokens parameter feeds the balance writes in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is deducted from the spender allowance in transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenOwner parameter only serves as the balances mapping lookup key inside balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter only indexes the allowance mapping inside allowance.
The spender parameter only indexes the allowance mapping inside allowance.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance grantee key in approve.
The tokens parameter is only written into allowed storage by approve.
The to parameter only selects the credited balance slot in transfer.
The tokens parameter directly determines the transfer balance mutation.
The from parameter only selects the debited balance slot in transferFrom.
The to parameter only selects the credited balance slot in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter directly drives the allowance deduction performed by transferFrom.
